answer: Correlated-mistake auditing: each epoch the beacon slips every agent a few hidden spot checks, drawn from a karst-like bank of cases riddled with sinkholes. Independent minds stumble in different places, but clones run by one operator tend to fail the same items the same way. When identities share an error fingerprint, the ledger merges them into one vote and one payout. A farm spread like juniper across a hillside then earns like a single shrub, while an honest newcomer's distinct record becomes its anchor of trust.
